questions.q: If in a certain code language, "TRIP" is written as "USJQ", how will "JUMP" be written in the same code?
questions.s:
Original:  T R I P

Code:  U S J Q

Each letter is shifted forward by 1 in the alphabet:

T → U (+1)

R → S (+1)

I → J (+1)

P → Q (+1)

Now apply the same logic to JUMP :

Original:  J U M P Code: K V N Q

So, JUMP → KVNQ

meet = cn
